title: Double-Precision Megasite
description: Stress-tests xeokit's double-precision world transforms by placing a kilometre-scale procedurally-generated site at very large world coordinates that would jitter under standard float32 WebGL. Vertex coordinates stay local and small; only the transforms and the model's coordinate-system origin carry the large values. The renderer's relative-to-camera tiling keeps motion stable even when the camera is zoomed in close to geometry that sits millions of units from the world origin.
